label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name flows directly into StringBuilder via append(param), then toString creates bar which is placed in an array written to HTTP response via printf. The appended suffix '_SafeStuff' does not sanitize HTML entities (e.g., '<script>' remains executable), so XSS is possible.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request, passed to doSomething, appended to StringBuilder, converted to String, and written to response without HTML encoding.
